title: 第15章 姜怀玉的手段
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
“你……看什么？”

    陆沉连忙移开视线：“没、没什么。”

    姜怀玉把灵果放在桌上，在他对面坐下。赤着的脚不自觉地缩了缩，藏到裙摆下面。

    “这衣裳……”她低着头，声音细若蚊吟。

    “是以前买的，一直没敢穿。今天……想着反正就咱们两个人在家……”

    陆沉不敢接话，埋头扒饭。

    姜怀玉也不再说什么，小口小口地吃着，偶尔给他夹菜。

    气氛安静，却不像中午那般自然。

    空气中弥漫着一种说不清道不明的暧昧。

    陆沉心里乱成一团。

    王峰那张憔悴的脸在脑海里挥之不去，而眼前这个温柔给他夹菜的女人，就是王峰要找的人。

    他必须开口。

    “师姐。”

    姜怀玉抬眸看他。

    “我有好消息告诉你。”

    “什么好消息？”

    “王师兄他……”陆沉顿了顿，“他后悔了。”

    姜怀玉夹菜的动作停住了。

    “今天他叫我们过去，就是想说这件事。他说他错了，要给你道歉，并且不在意女儿不管是谁的，都是他的女儿，谁也改变不了。”

    “他还说，你要是原谅他，他就天天去你门口跪着。你要打要骂都行，只要你回去。”

    姜怀玉没说话，只是低着头。

    “师姐？”

    “吃饭吧，过去的事，就让他过去吧。”

    姜怀玉声音很轻，像是在说一件无关紧要的小事。

    陆沉懵了，他没想到姜怀玉是这种反应。

    她可以是生气，也可以是委屈，但唯独不能是平静。

    “可是师兄他是真心悔过……”

    “我知道。”姜怀玉打断他。

    “可有些事情，不是悔过就能当做什么都没发生的，你说呢？”

    她说话的时候，目光一直落在陆沉身上，温柔得像在看什么珍贵的东西。
content_en:
"What...are you looking at?"

Lu Chen quickly looked away: "No, it's nothing."

Jiang Huaiyu put the spirit fruit on the table and sat down opposite him.Her bare feet shrank unconsciously and were hidden under her skirt.

"These clothes..." She lowered her head, her voice as soft as a mosquito's moan.

"I bought it before, but I never dared to wear it. Today...I thought it would be just the two of us at home anyway..."

Lu Chen didn't dare to answer the conversation and buried his head in eating.

Jiang Huaiyu said nothing and ate in small bites, occasionally picking up vegetables for him.

The atmosphere is quiet, but not as natural as noon.

There was an inexplicable ambiguity in the air.

Lu Chen was in a mess.

Wang Feng's haggard face lingered in his mind, and the woman in front of him who gently served him food was the person Wang Feng was looking for.

He must speak.

"Sister."

Jiang Huaiyu raised his eyes to look at him.

"I have good news for you."

"What good news?"

"Senior Brother Wang..." Lu Chen paused, "He regrets it."

Jiang Huaiyu stopped picking up vegetables.

"He called us over today just to say this. He said he was wrong and wanted to apologize to you, and he didn't care who the daughter was, it was his daughter and no one could change it."

"He also said that if you forgive him, he will kneel at your door every day. You can beat or scold him if you want, as long as you go back."

Jiang Huaiyu didn't speak, just lowered his head.

"Sister?"

"Let's eat. Let the past be bygones."

Jiang Huaiyu's voice was very soft, as if he was talking about a trivial matter.

Lu Chen was stunned. He didn't expect Jiang Huaiyu to react like this.

She could be angry or aggrieved, but she couldn't be calm.

"But senior brother, he sincerely regrets..."

"I know." Jiang Huaiyu interrupted him.

"But there are some things that you can't just regret and pretend that nothing happened. What do you think?"

When she spoke, her eyes kept falling on Lu Chen, as tenderly as if she were looking at something precious.
